vision.name: Android Efficiency Drill
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Continuous]: Your energy attacks that deal life card damage after modifiers deal a minimum of 5 life cards of damage.
[Trait:Android]: If you have 2 or less Traits, you may destroy the top X cards of your Life Deck instead of paying the stage cost of an attack. X = the stage cost of that attack.
vision.note: landscape Drill layout, grey (non-styled) frame; alternate-art printing of R38 (the card prints 'R38'; 'B' is filename-only)
